title: Independent re-verification of Hotspawn CS2 pick coverage and of the no-line fallback for the four fixtures with no betting line, read first-hand on 2026-10-24
method: Read the live Hotspawn CS2 pick'ems lobby and its official scheduled-fixtures API directly, then reconciled both against the checked-in snapshot.json (inventory_observed_at 2026-10-24T14:24:12Z).
Read the live published origination feed to confirm what the deployed site actually shows, rather than assuming the checked-in replay fixture matches it.
For the fixtures the featured exact-name method could not price, read HLTV (match page and betting-analytics page) first, then an esportsbook aggregate (EGamersWorld), first-hand.

No probability, pick, alias or price was written by hand. Every number quoted below is either a provider-published price, an official HLTV display, or a value read out of the repository's own published files.

sources.role: Official Hotspawn CS2 pick'ems lobby (tier and tournament filter counts)
Official Hotspawn scheduled-fixtures API used by the collector
CCT Europe 2026 Series #12 subset of the same official API
Live published complete-picks feed served by the deployed site
HLTV match page: format, stage, ranks, betting block, fan vote
HLTV betting-analytics page: ranks, form, absence of any money line
HLTV event page: GLuck Moscow Cyber Games 2026 fixtures 2399437 and 2399438 with format
EGamersWorld match page: displayed prices for Acend vs UNITY Esports
EGamersWorld match page: displayed prices for Rooster vs Team Abyssal

differences.finding: The official scheduled-fixtures API returns exactly the three fixtures the snapshot carries (1081154, 1081156, 1081158), so the collector is complete against its own source. The lobby, which counts every card in the current pick'em week including cards that are no longer returned as scheduled, shows one further Series #12 card.
differences.note: The extra lobby card is not a pick that was skipped: it is absent from the scheduled API, and the lobby rendered only future cards, so no lockable Series #12 card was available to pick. Whether it is a completed, cancelled or de-listed fixture could not be verified from a first-party page, so it is not asserted here.

lobby_reconciliation.note_on_rendered_cards: The lobby render listed 22 future cards (10 Closing Soon, 12 Upcoming). The snapshot's 23 open fixtures are those 22 plus 1083121 (Projeto do KinGui vs MEIA NOITE, start 2026-10-24T16:00:00Z), which had already passed its 15:54Z lock when the lobby was read and therefore no longer rendered as pickable.
lobby_reconciliation.conclusion: Every copy of fixture data read for this session agrees on the pickable set: 23 open fixtures at the 14:24:12Z observation, and the one per-tournament count difference is explained by the lobby week counter, with the collector matching its official API exactly.

published_pick_coverage.finding: The deployed site prices all 23 open fixtures: 19 from an external line (8 market + 5 bookmaker + 5 median consensus + 1 aggregated bookmaker average) and 4 from a labelled research model. Header and complete-list counts on the live pages agree (23 picks ready of 23, 0 unresolved).

collector_health_in_the_same_run.note: The EGamersWorld live index is blocked for the GitHub Actions runner (403, Cloudflare) while the same public pages answered a first-hand read from this session's egress; that is an automation obstacle, not evidence that no market exists.

hltv.betting_block: One row only: 'Stake - Sweapstake - US ... America's Social Casino - Play For Free ... No promocode available'. No two-sided money line is published.
hltv.fan_vote: 18.5% Acend / 81.5% UNiTY - a community poll, excluded from every calculation by project policy
hltv.analytics_page: https://www.hltv.org/betting/analytics/2399112/acend-vs-unity-nodwin-clutch-series-13 publishes pros/cons and form ('UNiTY has won 5 out of the last 5 matches', 'Acend has won 3 out of the last 5 matches') and no odds.

esportsbook.verdict: Both sides show an identical 1.8. Identical two-sided prices are a site placeholder, not a market: they imply no edge and are the exact pattern scripts/reference_odds.py refuses. Rejected as a line.

no_line_fixture_research.verdict: No usable external money line found first-hand. The published research-model estimate stands, and the limitation is that it is an uncalibrated rating estimate, not a price.

limitations: This session's sandbox had no direct outbound HTTP except through a page-reading tool, so no raw response body could be saved and hash-replayed for these reads; the URLs, the exact displayed values and the read window are recorded instead.
EGamersWorld match pages render a price widget that reads 1.8/1.8 for both of the low-tier fixtures checked. That is not a market and is deliberately not converted into a probability.
HLTV publishes no two-sided prematch line for 2399112 (promo row only). Its fan vote and 'pros/cons' panel are context, never inputs.
No probability, pick, alias or price was authored by hand in this session, and no checked-in data file was rewritten.
